aggregation: No composite score. Report each check and dimension separately. A dimension is pass only when every declared check passes; untested checks remain untested.

severity.policy: Do not invent severity or tune it after seeing results; freeze before formal runs.

oracleConflictPolicy: Preserve platform, independent journey, and Proto judgments separately. Any applicable conflict is disputed/ambiguous/unsupported and requires independent adjudication; Proto never wins automatically.

repairPolicy.formal: Predeclare the same budget per comparison cell; first-pass and final outcomes remain separate.

claims: Handwritten public fixture smoke test only. Passing is not model, Proto conformance, hidden-isolation, screen-reader, generated-target, or full P0 acceptance evidence.
